final_answer:
**Direct answer:** Black Condor II (Ryan Kendall) died in *Infinite Crisis* #1 (2005), where Sinestro killed him.

Claims and sources:

- Black Condor dies in *Infinite Crisis* #1. The issue's annotations list "Black Condor – killed by Sinestro" under "Deaths in this issue."
  https://crisisonearthprime.com/infinite-crisis/ic01/

- Sinestro killed him with a yellow power ring, during the Freedom Fighters' encounter with the Society at a Stagg Industries refinery outside Metropolis.
  https://crisisonearthprime.com/infinite-crisis/ic01/

- A second, independent review of the issue says "Sinestro kills Black Condor too!" while describing the Freedom Fighters walking into the villains' ambush.
  https://www.chrisisoninfiniteearths.com/2017/07/infinite-crisis-1-2005.html

- Ryan Kendall is the second Black Condor, and he was killed at the beginning of the *Infinite Crisis* storyline.
  https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Condor

- DCU Guide also says Black Condor II was killed by Sinestro as the Freedom Fighters were attacked by the Society. It gives no issue number.
  https://dcuguide.com/Black_Condor_(Ryan_Kendall)

**Gaps and caveats:**
- The "December 2005" cover date comes only from a search-result summary. I didn't read a page that states it, so treat it as unverified.
- The Fandom and Comic Vine pages returned HTTP 403, so I couldn't read them directly.
- The two sources that name issue #1 are fan-run annotation and review sites, not DC itself. No source I read named a different issue.
- He was later revived as a Black Lantern in *Blackest Night*. That doesn't change where he died, and I didn't verify it.
